workspace.closeTabHint: Close tab (also with the middle mouse button)
workspace.emptyWithMap: Select a material from the navigation or open the map.
workspace.emptyMaterials: Select a material from the navigation.

errors.campaignLoadFailed: Could not load the campaign. Check that the backend and database are running.
errors.materialNotFound: This material is not available in the campaign.
errors.materialLoadFailed: Could not open the material. Please try again.

material.heading: Heading
material.markdownHelp: Insert at the cursor or replace the selection. Headings, lists, quotes and tables are supported. HTML is kept as text. Images and external links are not supported.
material.linkHelp: The selected text becomes a link. Without a selection, the material title is inserted.

insertionErrors.notEditing: Return to editing and choose an insertion point.
insertionErrors.markdownTooLarge: The text is too long. Insert at most 65,536 characters at a time.
insertionErrors.invalidContent: Could not insert this text. Remove images and external links; use existing campaign material links.
insertionErrors.invalidMaterial: Choose a material available in this campaign.

errors.saveConflict: The material was changed in another window. Copy your draft and refresh the page to load the current version.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save. Your changes remain in this tab; retry after the connection is restored.
errors.clipboardUnavailable: The browser could not copy the text. Select the content and copy it manually.

game.title: Game
game.discardUnreadable: Discard unreadable pending request and refresh
game.partyHint: Add the characters taking part in the campaign. Setup starts the game clock at zero.
game.restHint: Advancing time alone does not record a rest. Long rest advances the clock by 8 hours and records its end for all characters.
game.toolFailed: Could not load the tool. Try again.
game.noTools: This module has no game tools.
game.undoHint: Restore the game state before the last operation, including time and character state. Material notes remain saved.
game.invalidParty: Enter a name for every character (up to 100 characters).
game.invalidMinutes: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 525,600.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load game state. Check the connection and refresh.
errors.operationUncertain: The operation could not be confirmed. Retry the pending request after restoring the connection; it will not be applied twice.
errors.refreshFailed: The operation was saved, but current state could not be loaded. Retry to confirm the current state.
errors.conflict: Game state changed in another window. Refresh before performing another action.
errors.rejected: This action is not available for the current game state. Check the input and refresh if needed.
errors.storageUnavailable: The browser could not preserve or clear the pending request. Enable session storage and retry to confirm the operation's outcome.
errors.invalidPending: The preserved pending request is unreadable. Refresh the current state before explicitly discarding it.
errors.invalidResponse: The game response could not be verified. Refresh or retry the pending request before continuing.

map.hint: Select a marker to open its description. Drag the map to move it.
